reference_sql:
WITH be14_lines AS (  -- one row per BE-14 order line of 2024, as stored
  SELECT ol.order_id, ol.product_id, ol.quantity, ol.unit_price_eur, ol.promo_id, ol.line_discount_eur
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  WHERE s.store_code = 'BE-14'
    AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
),
line_sets AS (  -- one row per set of matching lines
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_lines
  FROM be14_lines
  GROUP BY order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_eur, promo_id, line_discount_eur
)
SELECT SUM(n_lines) AS n_stored, COUNT(*) AS n_unique, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 11239 THEN 'pass' ELSE 'fail' END AS result
FROM line_sets

solver.query:
WITH l AS (
  SELECT ol.order_id, ol.product_id, ol.quantity, ol.unit_price_eur, ol.promo_id, ol.line_discount_eur
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  WHERE s.store_code = 'BE-14' AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
),
u AS (SELECT DISTINCT * FROM l),
c AS (SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM l) AS n_stored, (SELECT count(*) FROM u) AS n_unique)
SELECT n_stored, n_unique, CASE WHEN n_unique = 11239 THEN 'pass' ELSE 'fail' END AS result FROM c
